# WO-202: Refresh the families page
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Make family-related guidance easier to understand, with considerate language and a clear path through the existing content.

## Acceptance criteria
- Preserve the existing audience, limits, and verified facts; do not imply account sharing, broader coverage, or outcomes not supported by the product.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Use readable sections and a clear sequence; avoid fear-based imagery or copy.
- Add focused built-output checks for key headings, links, and the order of the guidance.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit each claim against D8; flag any claim outside its allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/families/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_families_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No app workflows, privacy/security behavior, global styles, shared tokens, CSP, or dependencies.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_families_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_families_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-206 is integrated on a main containing reviewed foundation.

## Notes and decisions
Keep language plain and reassuring without claims of guaranteed results.
